info.name: Integrations and Support Support Endpoints API
info.description:
The Integrations and Support API defines endpoints for configuring integrations with Plaid, Flinks, Inverite, and Global Pay, managing API keys, and handling support tickets. It also includes endpoints for setting and testing webhook URLs, and fetching webhook notifications for account and partner accounts.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

If an email address is passed in, it will fetch all tickets for the account that have been submitted, including CC'd, by that email.

request.description: This endpoint is used to submit a comment on an existing support tickets via our API. Ticket comments represent the conversation between user and support team. Use the TicketID (obtained from /account/submit-ticket endpoint) to identify the ticket you want to attach the comment to

urlencoded.description: (Required) The full name of the submitter of your ticket
(Required) Base64 code of the attachment content
The name of the file being attached. It defaults to attachment if the name is not provided.

request.description:
You can upload a file and attach it to an existing support tickets via our API. Use the TicketID (obtained from /account/submit-ticket endpoint) to identify the ticket you want to attach the file to. Here are some rules regarding the document requirements:

* The maximum allowed file size is 10Mb

* Files must be sent as base64. Make sure the base64 code is valid (must contain the initial file information. E.g. data:image/jpeg;base64

*

urlencoded.description: (Required) Base64 code of the attachment content
The name of the file being attached. It defaults to attachment if the name is not provided.
